content.comment_body: Hello, I am working with the [product_name] module using PT100 and PT1000 sensors. My goal is to achieve identical output for both sensors while extending the PT100 range to a maximum of 550°C. Changing the gain allowed me to reach 550°C, but the temperature readings do not match those from PT1000.

This adjustment is not feasible. The [product_name] module has a preset temperature range of -50 to 200°C, which cannot be altered. For measurements above this range, you will need an external PT converter with a higher temperature span, such as 0 to 600°C and an output of 0-10V or 0/4-20mA.
However, when I purchased this module, the description stated a different range.
It is correct that the PT sensor itself can have a different range. The limitation comes from the [product_name] module, which only supports a fixed range of -50 to 200°C. This cannot be modified.
I see, now it makes sense. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are attempting to configure the [product_name] module to read temperatures up to 550°C using PT100 and PT1000 sensors. They encounter a restriction due to the module's fixed measurement range of -50 to 200°C, resulting in a mismatch between what the user expects and what the hardware can deliver. Discrepancies between product documentation and marketing materials lead to user confusion regarding the module's capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that the [product_name] module can be adjusted to measure up to 550°C with PT100 and PT1000 sensors and deliver consistent readings for both, based on information given in product descriptions.
